name: complex_video_bench_previs24
description: Original public-brief tasks for evaluating controllable video tool paths. No solver is prescribed, no reference assets are required, no Blender integration is installed by this pack.

workflow_sources.role: Official white-model, multimodal reference and editing workflow motivation
Author-maintained example of exportable previs motion-reference assets and agent-facing controls
Earlier GPT4Motion precedent for LLM-scripted Blender conditioning; not a novel idea claimed here

tasks.prompt:
Create a 12-second video. A compact gallery has one rectangular doorway, a stationary spiral sculpture on a round plinth, and a red bench behind it. The sculpture never moves.
Use a single continuous take with no cuts.
0-4 seconds: Start outside the doorway and dolly through its center toward the sculpture.
4-8 seconds: Arc around the sculpture to the viewer's right, revealing the red bench behind it.
8-12 seconds: Rise gently to a high oblique view while keeping the same plinth in frame; settle without a cut.
Required invariants: Only the camera moves; the sculpture, plinth and bench stay fixed in world space. The doorway is crossed once, not replaced by a different opening. Perspective and occlusion change continuously rather than by morphing the room.
Do not add captions, watermarks, motion-path guides, axes or debug overlays. Audio is not evaluated.

tasks.prompt:
Create a 12-second video. A miniature street contains a blue kiosk in front of a low brick building. A yellow water tank sits on the building's flat roof. All objects are stationary.
Use a single continuous take with no cuts.

4-8 seconds: Crane upward without crossing through the building until the tank becomes visible.
8-12 seconds: Move slightly forward into a downward-looking view containing kiosk, roof and tank together.
Required invariants: The tank must be revealed by the viewpoint change, not appear from nowhere. The kiosk remains outside and in front of the same building. The camera never passes through solid walls or the roof.
Do not add captions, watermarks, motion-path guides, axes or debug overlays. Audio is not evaluated.
